input: 16 kHz mono speech and a model folder (config.json, vocab.json, model.safetensors).
output: The log probabilities of the model's letters every 20 ms.
specification: AGENTS.md 2026-11-05 (user: cutting by letters in the script, pure Rust). A wav2vec2 CTC model (stable layer norm, XLS-R) in pure Rust with candle; the weights are only read.
